4a17b8f8885f2e2afdf7918ca0367550.overview: After an embarrassing incident at work, suburban family man William Ronald Trosper finds himself investigating a far-reaching conspiracy.

4a20187d06db7c148a5f51f671fd3964.overview: Mr. Bean wins a trip to Cannes where he unwittingly separates a young boy from his father and must help the two reunite. On the way he discovers France, bicycling and true love, among other things.
4a20187d06db7c148a5f51f671fd3964.tagline: Disaster is just a small step away.

4a216026368c30ee549a024720f9dce5.overview: In 1970s London, a teenage outsider named Enn falls in love with a rebellious alien girl named Zan, who has come to Earth for a party. Together, they navigate the complexities of intergalactic culture and the trials of first love.
4a216026368c30ee549a024720f9dce5.tagline: Some girls are out of this world.

4a25bda40acffe1274e20daefc2475d2.overview: Hollywood, 1927: As silent movie star George Valentin wonders if the arrival of talking pictures will cause him to fade into oblivion, he sparks with Peppy Miller, a young dancer set for a big break.
4a25bda40acffe1274e20daefc2475d2.tagline: A breath of fresh vintage air.

4a2af722fea51832cb1b7e02761db026.overview: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if a young Spanish-American is guilty or innocent of murdering his father. What begins as an open and shut case soon becomes a mini-drama of each of the jurors' prejudices and preconceptions about the trial, the accused, and each other.
4a2af722fea51832cb1b7e02761db026.tagline: It explodes like 12 sticks of dynamite!

4a2df89a64b09a8e380ff48501a85ee7.overview: In an effort to be able to afford expensive treatment for her gravely ill American husband, a retired German entertainer returns to the cabaret as Blonde Venus and catches the eye of a wealthy politician.
4a2df89a64b09a8e380ff48501a85ee7.tagline: What could she do but flee from love? She loved two men at once!

4a36db775e3c874e8e09025e56835bed.overview: In 1927, Charles Lindbergh struggles to finance and design an airplane that will make his New York to Paris flight the first solo transatlantic crossing.
4a36db775e3c874e8e09025e56835bed.tagline: One of the Great Adventures of Our Time!

4a411d8726b695aac1cd8d28734f2387.overview: This pioneering documentary film depicts the lives of the indigenous Inuit people of Canada's northern Quebec region. Although the production contains some fictional elements, it vividly shows how its resourceful subjects survive in such a harsh climate, revealing how they construct their igloo homes and find food by hunting and fishing. The film also captures the beautiful, if unforgiving, frozen landscape of the Great White North, far removed from conventional civilization.
4a411d8726b695aac1cd8d28734f2387.tagline: A story of life and love in the actual Arctic.

4a64ccb1444253f5438a650700b54c03.overview: Jack Slavin is an environmentalist with a heart condition who lives with his daughter, Rose, on an isolated island. While Jack fights against developers who wish to build in the area, he also craves more contact with other people. When he invites his girlfriend, Kathleen, and her sons, Rodney and Thaddius, to move in, Rose is upset. The complicated family dynamics makes things difficult for everyone in the house.
4a64ccb1444253f5438a650700b54c03.tagline: Selfhood begins with a walking away, and love is proved in the letting go.

4a8c56c583d51f47b80081a2716f956b.overview: An experimental short film which compares and contrasts the colors of carrots and peas.

4a91c77e1ce56bde52cd8f4a1d3821c1.overview: French sailor Querelle arrives in Brest and starts frequenting a strange whorehouse. He discovers that his brother Robert is the lover of the lady owner, Lysiane. Here, you can play dice with Nono, Lysiane's husband: if you win, you are allowed to make love with Lysiane; if you lose, you have to make love with Nono... Querelle loses on purpose.
4a91c77e1ce56bde52cd8f4a1d3821c1.tagline: It will take you into a surreal world of passion and sexuality, further than most would dare to go.

4ab653335cf95139969cd964ec1c71e3.overview: Director Claude Lanzmann spent 11 years on this sprawling documentary about the Holocaust, conducting his own interviews and refusing to use a single frame of archival footage. Dividing Holocaust witnesses into three categories – survivors, bystanders, and perpetrators – Lanzmann presents testimonies from survivors of the Chelmno concentration camp, an Auschwitz escapee, and witnesses of the Warsaw Ghetto Uprising, as well as a chilling report of gas chambers from an SS officer at Treblinka.

4acbab18a010bf02bbfb8d2beaf52718.overview: At a 1930s New Orleans bordello, Hallie is the main attraction for both clients and the shrewd madam. The arrival of Dove Linkhorn, her lovesick sweetheart from three years ago, disrupts the normal and triggers a chain of events involving a number of people, including the young woman he travelled with, who is now the Doll House's newest employee.
4acbab18a010bf02bbfb8d2beaf52718.tagline: A side of life you never expected to see on the screen!

4ad02d1eea545498a4bfb2469883bb5e.overview: During the 1976 Soweto uprising, a white school teacher's life and values are threatened when he asks questions about the death of a young black boy who died in police custody.

4afccc4c4de68aaaabe4df3cd032da10.overview: A hapless young man living in New York City rallies to save his girlfriend's grandfather's horse-drawn trolley, the last in the city, from being put out of business by a railroad company.
4afccc4c4de68aaaabe4df3cd032da10.tagline: You've Waited a Year for This But WOW! What a Hit!
